name: Ingredients for the Forge
label: Quest
description: Ingredients for the Forge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!
I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
